description: The news came out yesterday that the latest Trump Administration soap opera episode led to the firing of Secretary of the Navy John Phelan. While being a billionaire contributor and veteran of the finance industry are wonderful credentials these days, they didn't make him a good pick to be SECNAV, so I shed no tears at his departure. But it's just another demonstration that SECDEF Pete Hegseth is interested only in assembling a team of pushovers and yes men who are willing to swear allegiance
